brief: public String detect(Path path) throws IOException{}
method_comment:
* Detects the media type of the file at the given path. The type * detection is based on the document content and a potential known * file extension. *

* Use the {@link #detect(String)} method when you want to detect the * type of the document without actually accessing the file. * * @param path the path of the file * @return detected media type * @throws IOException if the file can not be read
